Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 자신감을 잃은 것처럼 보인다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looked unwell after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼を失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は自信をなくしたようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起来像是失去了自信。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起來像是失去了自信。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, ayant échoué la mission, semble avoir perdu confiance en lui.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, der die Aufgabe nicht erfüllt hat, scheint sein Selbstvertrauen verloren zu haben.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, quien fracasó en la misión, parece haber perdido la confianza.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que falhou na missão, parece ter perdido a confiança.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ดูเหมือน <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ล้มเหลวในการรับมอบหมายนั้น สูญเสียความเชื่อมั่นในตัวเอง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang gagal menyelesaikan misi terlihat kehilangan kepercayaan diri.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trông như đã mất tự tin sau khi thất bại trong nhiệm vụ.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: How about we go have some tea together?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 気晴らしに、お茶でも飲みに行かない？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 要不要先一起去喝个茶转换心情？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 要不要先一起去喝個茶轉換心情？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Sollen wir uns einen Tee gönnen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Que tal irmos juntos tomar algo, já que estamos aqui?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ไปดื่มชาด้วยกันก่อนไหม?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Apakah kita mau minum teh bersama saja?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Tạm uống trà cùng nhau nhé?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: I hope this lifts your spirits, at least a little.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: とりあえず、これ飲んで。少しは楽になるかも。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 希望喝了茶之后能打起精神。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 希望喝了茶之後能打起精神。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: J'espère que tu te sentiras mieux en buvant au moins ça.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Ich hoffe, du trinkst das und fühlst dich besser.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Espero que al menos bebas esto y recuperes fuerzas.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Espero que você se sinta melhor depois de beber isto.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ถ้าได้ดื่มนี่แล้วรู้สึกสดชื่นขึ้นก็คงดี
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Semoga kamu bisa menyegarkan diri dengan minum ini.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Tôi hy vọng uống cái này sẽ giúp bạn lấy lại tinh thần.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 기운을 차린 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(와)과 함께 차를 마시기 위해 돌아갔다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I headed back to share some tea with <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> who had recovered her spirits.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 元気を取り戻した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>とともに、お茶を飲みに向かった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 和重新振作的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>一起回去喝茶了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 和重新振作的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>一起回去喝茶了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Je suis retourné(e) boire du thé avec <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> qui avait repris ses esprits.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ich bin mit dem erfrischten <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> zurückgekehrt, um Tee zu trinken.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Regresamos con <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> que se había recuperado para tomar té juntos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Voltei para tomar chá com <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que havia recuperado o ânimo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันกลับมาเพื่อดื่มชาพร้อมกับ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ได้ความกำลังใจคืน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Kami kembali untuk minum teh bersama <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang telah pulih semangatnya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tôi quay lại để uống trà cùng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã lấy lại tinh thần.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I could see <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s disappointment in herself.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の横顔に、自身への失望がにじんでいた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 从<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的神情中能看出她对自己的失望。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 從<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的神情中能看出她對自己的失望。
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mostró una leve desilusión consigo mismo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> มีความผิดหวังต่อตัวเองที่ปรากฏออกมา
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Từ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có thể nhìn thấy sự thất vọng về chính mình.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 감사를 전한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 얼굴에 다시금 생기가 돌았다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> offered her thanks and seemed to brighten considerably.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 感謝を伝えた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の面差に、ようやく明るさが戻ってきた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 向你道谢的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>脸上再次恢复了神采。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 向你道謝的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>臉上再次恢復了神采。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: La gratitude exprimée par <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a ravivé l'éclat sur son visage.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Im Gesicht von <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, der Dankbarkeit aussprach, kehrte wieder Leben zurück.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El rostro de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, quien expresó gratitud, volvió a cobrar vida.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: O rosto de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que havia expressado gratidão, ganhou vida novamente.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ความสดใสปรากฏขึ้นอีกครั้งบนใบหน้าของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ได้รับการกล่าวขอบคุณ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Kehidupan kembali bersinar di wajah <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> yang telah mengucapkan terima kasih.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sự sống động lại xuất hiện trên khuôn mặt của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> người đã truyền đạt lòng biết ơn.
